scope: Immutable real-file read, production native undo timeline/index, selection/planning and native schedule validation. No CSP input, new brush capture, paste or undo-stack readback.

preciseUndo.Limitation: A valid dependency plan and original native schedule still need CSP brush capture and checkpoint pixel validation. No execution or pixel verification has been invented.

eventEditing.Limitation: A valid dependency plan and original native schedule still need CSP brush capture and checkpoint pixel validation. No execution or pixel verification has been invented.

undoRegressionCoverage.Note: A legal plan on a newly drawn stroke after Undo does not establish this regression's coverage. Coverage requires actual changed contacts from before the first recorded Undo, with valid original checkpoint schedules.
